mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with three consecutive months of FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with UNRATE above 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) and rise in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates a demand shift from housing to services, boosting corporate revenue visibility and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The HOUST decline/RSAFS rise interaction fails to predict positive returns in more than 45% of cases (20-day returns negative when both conditions hold), or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 12-month moving average signals manufacturing slowdown that precedes earnings deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, INDPRO decline does not yield negative 60-day returns in >55% of cases, or Rank IC for INDPRO in this regime < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly growth in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over two consecutive quarters indicates robust consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods with two consecutive quarters of RSAFS growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% for two consecutive months signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces equity valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates accelerating labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and corporate hiring, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The PAYEMS decline/UNRATE rise interaction fails to predict negative returns in >45% of cases (5-day returns positive when both conditions hold), or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.5% annualized signals persistent inflation that triggers further rate hikes, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, CPIAUCSL > 3.5% annualized does not yield negative 20-day returns in >55% of cases, or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL in this regime < 0.02.
